findings.title: U2 EP has no thermal via
findings.detail: No via centre is inside the U2 exposed pad; nearest GND via is 1.40 mm away. The EP relies on lateral B.Cu/FR4 spreading. theta_JA is unknown and the as-built value is likely worse than a via-filled EP.

findings.title: U2 passes at 4 V input but not at 5 V input at 85 C ambient
findings.detail: At 0.2484 W and theta_JA=120 C/W, Tj(85 C)=114.8 C (10.2 C margin). At 5 V input (0.510 W), Tj(85 C)=146.2 C, above 125 C. The 4 V buck rail is therefore part of the thermal budget.

findings.title: Full white is electrically unsupported and thermally hot
findings.detail: 1.14 A through 76 LEDs is 4.56 W; the 2D model gives an 83.1 C board maximum at 25 C ambient and 143.1 C at 85 C ambient. U7 latches off at 173.7-233.9 mA, so this is a what-if, not an operating point.

findings.title: Limiter-capped LED case is thermally feasible in the model
findings.detail: At 0.761656 mA/channel (0.1737 A, 0.693 W LED heat), the model gives a 42 C board maximum at 25 C ambient and 102 C at 85 C ambient; U2 Tj is 109.6 C at 85 C with the board-model R_jb, and 114.8 C with theta_JA=120 C/W.

findings.title: U18 and U7 are not the thermal limit
findings.detail: U18 loss is 0.060 W at 0.1 A and 0.119 W at 0.3 A; Tj(85 C) is 98.3 C with the JEDEC 112.2 C/W value. U7 loss is 4.1-7.4 mW at the limiter currents; Tj rise is <1.4 C.

findings.title: Board/case time constant is minutes, not seconds
findings.detail: The 2D model gives t63 ~775 s and t90 ~1970 s for the board maximum at full white; the case is slower (t63 ~1260 s). A short bench test will not reach steady state.

measurements_needed: Thermocouple or IR camera on U2, U18, L2, U7 and several LEDs at 25/40/60/85 C ambient.

Case internal air temperature and case external surface temperature; case material/emissivity.
Actual SK6805 per-channel current and forward voltage at the firmware brightness cap.
TPS62932 efficiency at 4 V output, 5 V input, 4.7 uH and 0.1/0.3 A.
L2 DCR and temperature rise at 0.1/0.3 A.
U7 Rds(on) and case temperature at 0.17-0.23 A.
Confirm the LED rail never reaches full white before U7/eFuse current limit trips.
